title.narrative: Humanitarian assistance to vulnerable people affected by COVID in Kerala

description.narrative: In order to address the economic impact of COVID on the most vulnerable households, the project aims to provide unconditional multipurpose cash assistance of Rs.4000 to 275 families in Kannur and Kasargod districts of Kerala. The project also will provide livelihood assistance to 30 person with disability through cash assistance of Rs 30,000. Multipurpose cash assistance will be provided to most vulnerable and marginalised groups such as people with disability, women headed households, widows, LGBTQ, people with chronic illness, and destitute families. The project will contribute to Programme Objective 3 of CA India programme -' Poor, vulnerable and excluded communities affected by natural and human-made disasters (or impact of COVID 19) supported with immediate life - saving humanitarian response, recovery and rehabilitation addressing the needs and gaps'. The project will address the immediate needs as well as support livelihood recovery and resilience of people affected by crisis.
